title: Mistwood Ruins
note: Ruins in the Mistwood. A Runebear guards a cellar, and Blaidd's howl starts his quest here.

title: Coastal Cave
note: Two Demi-Human Chiefs at the end, and Boc the Seamster is trapped near the entrance.

title: Incantation Scarab
note: The reward for the Homing Instinct painting: a head piece that boosts incantations. Stand where the painting shows, north-west of Seaside Ruins, and a ghost appears with it.

title: Redmane Castle
note: Radahn's castle. During the Radahn Festival this is where the big fight starts.

title: Runebear disguised as a Wandering Noble
note: Kill the lone sword-holding noble east of Agheel Lake South. It turns into a Runebear and drops a Larval Tear.

title: Bloodhound Knight Darriwil
note: Boss of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Drops the Bloodhound's Fang curved greatsword.

title: Ruin-Strewn Precipice
note: A Golden Seed, Somber Smithing Stones and the Magma Wyrm Makar boss along the cliffs.

title: Grand Lift of Dectus
note: The big lift up to the Altus Plateau. Both Dectus Medallion halves make it work.

title: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
note: Light the three braziers to open the barrier and reach its loot, including Night Comet.

title: Caria Manor
note: Ranni's family manor. Royal Knight Loretta waits at the top, and three areas full of loot open behind it.

title: Tibia Mariner
note: A ghostly boatman boss on the east Liurnia shore near the Carian Study Hall.

title: Walking Mausoleum (central Liurnia)
note: A giant stone tomb on legs. Hit its feet, climb up, and use a Remembrance to duplicate a boss item.

title: Gael Tunnel
note: The Moonveil katana is inside, guarded by a Magma Wyrm.

title: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
note: A Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] and the Faithful's Canvas Talisman.

title: Homing Instinct Painting
note: The painting in Limgrave's Artist's Shack. It points to the Incantation Scarab near the Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

title: Callu Baptismal Church
note: A Sacred Tear in the church, next to the Ailing Village.

title: Royal Knight Loretta
note: Caria Manor's final boss. Drops Loretta's Greatbow and unlocks Ranni's Rise and the Three Sisters.

title: Erdtree Avatar (Liurnia southwest)
note: A giant root guardian under the Minor Erdtree, plus a Cerulean Crystal Tear.

title: Omenkiller
note: Boss of the Village of the Albinaurics. There's a Larval Tear in the village graveyard too.

title: Chelona's Rise
note: A tower near the Moonlight Altar, in Ranni's quest territory.

title: Miranda the Blighted Bloom
note: A giant flower boss in Tombsward Cave. Drops a cookbook and an amber medallion.

title: Bell Bearing Hunter (Dragonbarrow)
note: At night this shack is guarded by a Bell Bearing Hunter who drops a merchant's bell bearing.

title: Grafted Scion disguised as a Giant Crayfish
note: The patrolling crayfish south of Fallen Ruins of the Lake. It drops a Larval Tear.

title: Walking Mausoleum (Weeping Peninsula)
note: This one walks around the western Weeping Peninsula.
